decisions.reason: The trommel screen builds directly on the firm's existing screening and separating knowledge and shows market acceptance, so absorptive capacity supports keeping it.
Mobile flail shredders extend the firm's existing processing machinery and benefit from related engineering and service knowledge, making them likely to be retained.
The mobile high-speed grinder is adjacent to the firm's existing material-processing and size-reduction expertise, so the firm can interpret results and improve it.
The stationary electric fine shredder fits the firm's established stationary plant and shredding knowledge, allowing learning and retention.
The green-waste grinder leverages the firm's biomass and composting-related processing knowledge, so it is close enough to existing capabilities to keep.
Stationary single-shaft pre-shredders build on existing shredding and stationary equipment knowledge, supporting retention.
